title: Ledger Recorder
description: Implement `lib/wdd/ledger.py` containing the `append_entry` function. This function must hash the previous ledger entry and the current envelope/receipt to cryptographically chain the execution history.

requirements.hash_chain: Read the last entry in `ledger/`, calculate its SHA-256 hash, and inject it as `previous_hash` into the new entry.

acceptance_criteria: The ledger module appends a valid JSON file passing `ledger.schema.json`.
failure_modes: FAIL: Failing to initialize the Genesis block if the ledger is empty.
